pandas.read_iceberg

pandas 3.1.1 · Input and output · function

    columns=None,
    row_filter=None,
    case_sensitive=True,
    snapshot_id=None,
    limit=None,

Example for a local Python session
import pandas as pd
# Use an Iceberg catalog configured for your Python environment.
orders = pd.read_iceberg("sales.orders", catalog_name="warehouse", columns=["units"], limit=5)
print(orders)
